findings.evidence: `private lemma Q_map_eq_zero_of_homologyMap_eq_zero (g : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor C n).obj P ⟶ L) (hg : homologyMap g n = 0) : Q.map g = 0`; no equivalent found by grep in ./mathlib or ./code/TauCeti.
findings.fix: Make it public under a descriptive name, e.g. `DerivedCategory.Q_map_eq_zero_of_projective_of_homologyMap_eq_zero`. Better still, state the stronger homotopy-category form (`HomotopyCategory.quotient` map is zero, or `Nonempty (Homotopy g 0)`) and derive the `Q` version.
findings.issue: `Q_map_eq_zero_of_homologyMap_eq_zero` is `private` but is general infrastructure: for a projective `P`, a chain map `(singleFunctor C n).obj P ⟶ L` vanishing on `Hⁿ` is null-homotopic (zero after `Q`). Its statement involves only Mathlib types and does not depend on the main theorem.

findings.evidence: `omit [HasDerivedCategory.{w} C] in private lemma exists_homologyMap_eq (α : P ⟶ L.homology n) : ∃ g : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor C n).obj P ⟶ L, homologyMap g n = ...`; grep finds no counterpart in Mathlib.
findings.fix: Make it public in the `HomologicalComplex`/`CochainComplex` namespace under a descriptive name, e.g. `CochainComplex.exists_homologyMap_eq_of_projective`.
findings.issue: `exists_homologyMap_eq` is `private` but is a standalone general fact: for a projective `P`, every `P ⟶ Hⁿ(L)` is the cohomology of a chain map from `P` placed in degree `n`. It is a cochain-complex statement with no dependency on the derived category; the file already omits `HasDerivedCategory` for it.

summary: The derived-category surface and the closure lemmas are well-scoped and annotated, but two general chain-level results in HomFromProjective.lean are hidden as `private` instead of being exported.
